messages:
alex: Quick idea  mini mocktail tasting + card games this Friday on the rooftop? 6:30pm start, bring one non-alcoholic bottle and a small snack to share. vibes: chill + competitive :cocktail: :playing_cards:

jordan: love it. I can bring a few zero-proof mixers and a tiny travel deck of cards.

pri: i'm in if its under 8pm  later trains. also can make a pineapple-ginger mocktail (non-alc).

tony: count me in. can bring a portable bluetooth speaker and some chips. anyone up for a quick Uno tournament? :grin:

lunchbot: Poll created: "Start time" options: 6:00pm, 6:30pm, 7:00pm  vote with :one: :two: :three:. (poll id 11001)

jordan: voted :two: (6:30pm)

pri: voted :two: (6:30pm)

tony: voted :one: (6:00pm) but fine with majority 6:30

eventbot: Note: Rooftop reserved for community events 6:00pm-8:30pm. No glass bottles. (eventbot)

alex: great catch @eventbot  we'll do cans/bottles in plastic or insulated containers. I'll make a signup for snacks and mocktails.

jordan: remote folks  we'll set up a tablet so you can judge the mocktail round and vote via emoji.

pri: dietary note: i'm gluten-free. i'll label my snack.

tony: created a quick signup: https://tiny.redwood/mocktail-signup (placeholder)  please add your snack + any allergies.

alex: plan: meet 6:30, mingle, mocktail taste-off at ~6:50, then quick game rotations (Uno & micro card games). costumes optional (tropical shirts).

jordan: i'll bring a small prize for the mocktail winner  tiny succulent sticker pack :heart_eyes:

lunchbot: Reminder set: "Rooftop mocktail & cards" 2026-05-21 17:00 (local)

pri: if rain -> move to Lobby lounge A. anyone want to volunteer to fetch extra chairs?

ton y: I can grab chairs if needed.

alex: thanks Tony! final: rooftop 6:30, bring non-alc drink in non-glass container, one snack to share. remote welcome via tablet. see you Friday :tropical_drink:
